---
title: "Gauntlet Mantel and Procrustes Analyses"
output: html_document
---

# Purpose

This script tests associations among bacterial communities (16S), algal symbiont communities (ITS2), and host physiology. Mantel tests compare community and physiology distance matrices; Procrustes tests compare the 16S and ITS2 ordinations. It uses current saved analysis inputs and aligns samples by a reproducible parent-treatment-timepoint key. The legacy row-order matching and the `microViz` dependency have been removed.

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(phyloseq)
library(vegan)
library(cowplot)

set.seed(20261026)
mantel_permutations <- 999
species_order <- c("Montipora_capitata", "Porites_compressa", "Pavona_varians", "Pocillopora_acuta")
analysis_times <- c("T0", "T1", "TF")
analysis_treatments <- c("Ambient", "High")

make_key <- function(data) paste(data$Parent.ID, data$Treatment, data$Time.Point, sep = "|")

add_key_to_phyloseq <- function(ps) {
  metadata <- data.frame(sample_data(ps))
  metadata$gauntlet_key <- make_key(metadata)
  if (anyDuplicated(metadata$gauntlet_key)) stop("Duplicate Parent.ID/Treatment/Time.Point keys in a phyloseq object.")
  sample_data(ps) <- sample_data(metadata)
  sample_names(ps) <- metadata$gauntlet_key
  ps
}

subset_phyloseq_group <- function(ps, time_point, treatment = NULL, species = NULL) {
  metadata <- data.frame(sample_data(ps))
  keep <- metadata$Time.Point == time_point
  if (!is.null(treatment)) keep <- keep & metadata$Treatment == treatment
  if (!is.null(species)) keep <- keep & metadata$Species == species
  ps <- prune_samples(keep, ps)
  prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps) > 0, ps)
}

align_phyloseq_pair <- function(ps_a, ps_b) {
  shared <- sort(intersect(sample_names(ps_a), sample_names(ps_b)))
  if (length(shared) < 3) return(NULL)
  list(a = prune_samples(shared, ps_a), b = prune_samples(shared, ps_b))
}

align_phyloseq_physiology <- function(ps, physiology, time_point, treatment = NULL, species = NULL) {
  physiology_subset <- physiology %>% filter(Time.Point == time_point)
  if (!is.null(treatment)) physiology_subset <- physiology_subset %>% filter(Treatment == treatment)
  if (!is.null(species)) physiology_subset <- physiology_subset %>% filter(Species == species)
  physiology_subset <- physiology_subset %>% mutate(gauntlet_key = make_key(.))
  if (anyDuplicated(physiology_subset$gauntlet_key)) stop("Duplicate keys in the physiology dataframe.")
  shared <- sort(intersect(sample_names(ps), physiology_subset$gauntlet_key))
  if (length(shared) < 3) return(NULL)
  list(ps = prune_samples(shared, ps), physiology = physiology_subset %>% slice(match(shared, gauntlet_key)))
}

run_mantel <- function(distance_a, distance_b, comparison, pair_type) {
  shared <- sort(intersect(labels(distance_a), labels(distance_b)))
  if (length(shared) < 3) return(NULL)
  distance_a <- as.dist(as.matrix(distance_a)[shared, shared])
  distance_b <- as.dist(as.matrix(distance_b)[shared, shared])
  result <- vegan::mantel(distance_a, distance_b, permutations = mantel_permutations)
  data.frame(comparison = comparison, pair_type = pair_type, n = length(shared), r = unname(result$statistic), p = result$signif)
}

run_procrustes <- function(distance_a, distance_b, comparison) {
  shared <- sort(intersect(labels(distance_a), labels(distance_b)))
  if (length(shared) < 3) return(NULL)
  distance_a <- as.dist(as.matrix(distance_a)[shared, shared])
  distance_b <- as.dist(as.matrix(distance_b)[shared, shared])
  pcoa_a <- ape::pcoa(distance_a)$vectors
  pcoa_b <- ape::pcoa(distance_b)$vectors
  axes <- min(ncol(pcoa_a), ncol(pcoa_b))
  if (axes < 1) return(NULL)
  result <- vegan::protest(pcoa_a[, seq_len(axes), drop = FALSE], pcoa_b[, seq_len(axes), drop = FALSE], permutations = mantel_permutations)
  data.frame(comparison = comparison, n = length(shared), procrustes_correlation = result$t0, p = result$signif)
}

phylogeny_distance <- function(ps) phyloseq::distance(ps, method = "wunifrac")
its2_distance <- function(ps) phyloseq::distance(ps, method = "bray")

physiology_distance <- function(physiology, traits) {
  trait_data <- physiology[, traits, drop = FALSE]
  complete <- complete.cases(trait_data)
  if (sum(complete) < 3) return(NULL)
  trait_data <- scale(trait_data[complete, , drop = FALSE])
  distance <- dist(trait_data, method = "euclidean")
  attr(distance, "Labels") <- physiology$gauntlet_key[complete]
  distance
}

physiology_trait_sets <- list(
  "overall physiology" = c("Calcification", "AFDWmg.cm2", "Zoox Density", "Chl a", "Protein", "Fv/Fm", "Photosynthesis", "Respiration"),
  "host condition" = c("Calcification", "AFDWmg.cm2", "Protein"),
  "symbiont physiology" = c("Zoox Density", "Chl a", "Fv/Fm", "Photosynthesis")
)
```

# Load current data

```{r load-data}
# 16S: current bacterial phyloseq object produced by the 16S workflow.
environment_16s <- new.env()
load("Data/16s_phyloseq4HE.RData", envir = environment_16s)
ps_16s <- environment_16s$Bac.seq

# Remove control samples before creating matching keys.
metadata_16s <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_16s))
ps_16s <- prune_samples(metadata_16s$Time.Point %in% analysis_times & metadata_16s$Treatment %in% analysis_treatments, ps_16s)
ps_16s <- add_key_to_phyloseq(ps_16s)

# ITS2: current relative-abundance phyloseq object produced by the ITS2 workflow.
ps_its2 <- readRDS("Data/ITS2_phyloseq.rds")
ps_its2 <- add_key_to_phyloseq(ps_its2)

# Physiology: raw parent-treatment-timepoint values. Transformations and scaling are applied only in physiology_distance().
physiology_raw <- readRDS("Data/derived/PhysioData_mantel_source_raw.rds") %>%
  mutate(Parent.ID = as.character(Parent.ID), Treatment = as.character(Treatment), Time.Point = as.character(Time.Point), Species = gsub(" ", "_", Species))

bind_rows(data.frame(dataset = "16S", n = nsamples(ps_16s)), data.frame(dataset = "ITS2", n = nsamples(ps_its2)), data.frame(dataset = "Physiology", n = nrow(physiology_raw)))
```

# Baseline species trait-space figure

This three-panel figure shows the multivariate separation of the four host species at baseline (T0). Each panel uses all available T0 samples for that data type. Physiology uses scaled Euclidean distances across calcification, biomass, Symbiodiniaceae cell density, chlorophyll *a*, protein, Fv/Fm, photosynthesis, and respiration; P:R is excluded because it is derived from photosynthesis and respiration. Crosses indicate species centroids and ellipses show 95% dispersion.

```{r t0-species-trait-space, fig.width=13, fig.height=5.5}
t0_physiology_traits <- c("Calcification", "AFDWmg.cm2", "Zoox Density", "Chl a", "Protein", "Fv/Fm", "Photosynthesis", "Respiration")
t0_species_colors <- c(Montipora_capitata = "#D55E00", Porites_compressa = "#0072B2", Pavona_varians = "#009E73", Pocillopora_acuta = "#CC79A7")
t0_species_labels <- c(Montipora_capitata = "M. capitata", Porites_compressa = "P. compressa", Pavona_varians = "P. varians", Pocillopora_acuta = "P. acuta")

make_t0_ordination <- function(distance_matrix, metadata) {
  ordination <- ape::pcoa(distance_matrix)
  coordinates <- as.data.frame(ordination$vectors[, 1:2])
  names(coordinates) <- c("Axis1", "Axis2")
  coordinates$gauntlet_key <- rownames(coordinates)
  metadata <- metadata %>% mutate(gauntlet_key = if ("gauntlet_key" %in% names(.)) gauntlet_key else make_key(.)) %>% distinct(gauntlet_key, .keep_all = TRUE)
  coordinates <- left_join(coordinates, metadata, by = "gauntlet_key") %>% mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = species_order))
  list(data = coordinates, permanova = vegan::adonis2(distance_matrix ~ Species, data = coordinates, permutations = mantel_permutations), variance = ordination$values$Relative_eig[1:2] * 100)
}

make_t0_species_panel <- function(ordination, panel_title, distance_label) {
  centroids <- ordination$data %>% group_by(Species) %>% summarise(Axis1 = mean(Axis1), Axis2 = mean(Axis2), .groups = "drop")
  permanova <- ordination$permanova
  ggplot(ordination$data, aes(Axis1, Axis2, color = Species)) +
    stat_ellipse(level = 0.95, linewidth = 0.65, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_point(size = 2.4, alpha = 0.75) +
    geom_point(data = centroids, shape = 4, size = 4.2, stroke = 1.1, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(values = t0_species_colors, labels = t0_species_labels, drop = FALSE) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "none", plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12), plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9), axis.title = element_text(size = 10)) +
    labs(title = paste0(panel_title, " (", distance_label, ")"), subtitle = sprintf("PERMANOVA: R² = %.2f, p = %.3f; n = %d", permanova$R2[1], permanova$`Pr(>F)`[1], nrow(ordination$data)), x = sprintf("PCoA 1 (%.1f%%)", ordination$variance[1]), y = sprintf("PCoA 2 (%.1f%%)", ordination$variance[2]), color = "Host species")
}

ps_16s_t0 <- subset_phyloseq_group(ps_16s, "T0")
ps_its2_t0 <- subset_phyloseq_group(ps_its2, "T0")
physiology_t0 <- physiology_raw %>% filter(Time.Point == "T0") %>% filter(if_all(all_of(t0_physiology_traits), ~ !is.na(.)))
physiology_t0$gauntlet_key <- make_key(physiology_t0)

ordination_16s_t0 <- make_t0_ordination(phylogeny_distance(ps_16s_t0), data.frame(sample_data(ps_16s_t0)))
ordination_its2_t0 <- make_t0_ordination(its2_distance(ps_its2_t0), data.frame(sample_data(ps_its2_t0)))
physiology_t0_distance <- dist(scale(physiology_t0[, t0_physiology_traits]), method = "euclidean")
attr(physiology_t0_distance, "Labels") <- physiology_t0$gauntlet_key
ordination_physiology_t0 <- make_t0_ordination(physiology_t0_distance, physiology_t0)

panel_physiology_t0 <- make_t0_species_panel(ordination_physiology_t0, "A. Physiology", "scaled Euclidean")
panel_its2_t0 <- make_t0_species_panel(ordination_its2_t0, "B. ITS2", "Bray-Curtis")
panel_16s_t0 <- make_t0_species_panel(ordination_16s_t0, "C. 16S", "weighted UniFrac")

species_legend <- data.frame(Species = factor(species_order, levels = species_order), x = seq_along(species_order), y = 1, label = unname(t0_species_labels[species_order]))
legend_panel <- ggplot(species_legend, aes(x, y, color = Species)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), color = "black", vjust = -1.4, size = 3.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = t0_species_colors) +
  guides(color = "none") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.5, 4.5), ylim = c(0.75, 1.25), clip = "off") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(4, 25, 12, 25))

t0_species_trait_space <- cowplot::plot_grid(cowplot::plot_grid(panel_physiology_t0, panel_its2_t0, panel_16s_t0, ncol = 3, align = "hv"), legend_panel, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 0.15))
ggsave("Figures/Figure_T0_species_trait_space.pdf", t0_species_trait_space, width = 13, height = 5.5, bg = "white")
ggsave("Figures/Figure_T0_species_trait_space.png", t0_species_trait_space, width = 13, height = 5.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
t0_species_trait_space
```

# Mantel and Procrustes tests

Analyses are performed separately within each time point and, at T1 and TF, within treatment. Results are reported only when at least three matched records are available. The 16S distance is weighted UniFrac, ITS2 is Bray-Curtis, and each physiology distance is Euclidean after centering and scaling its raw traits. The overall physiology matrix excludes P:R because it is derived from photosynthesis and respiration. Host condition contains calcification, biomass, and protein; symbiont physiology contains cell density, chlorophyll *a*, Fv/Fm, and gross photosynthesis. Procrustes tests use PCoA coordinates from the matched 16S and ITS2 distance matrices.

```{r mantel-tests}
# Reset after the standalone T0 figure so Mantel/Procrustes permutation results remain reproducible.
set.seed(20261026)
mantel_results <- list()
append_result <- function(result) if (!is.null(result)) mantel_results[[length(mantel_results) + 1]] <<- result
procrustes_results <- list()
append_procrustes <- function(result) if (!is.null(result)) procrustes_results[[length(procrustes_results) + 1]] <<- result

for (time_point in analysis_times) {
  treatment_levels <- if (time_point == "T0") list(NULL) else as.list(analysis_treatments)
  for (treatment_name in treatment_levels) {
    group_label <- paste(c(time_point, treatment_name), collapse = "_")
    ps16_group <- subset_phyloseq_group(ps_16s, time_point, treatment_name)
    its2_group <- subset_phyloseq_group(ps_its2, time_point, treatment_name)
    for (species_name in c("all", species_order)) {
      species_filter <- if (species_name == "all") NULL else species_name
      comparison <- paste(group_label, species_name, sep = "_")
      ps16_species <- if (is.null(species_filter)) ps16_group else subset_phyloseq_group(ps_16s, time_point, treatment_name, species_filter)
      its2_species <- if (is.null(species_filter)) its2_group else subset_phyloseq_group(ps_its2, time_point, treatment_name, species_filter)
      aligned_microbes <- align_phyloseq_pair(ps16_species, its2_species)
      if (!is.null(aligned_microbes)) {
        comparison_16s_its2 <- paste(group_label, species_name, sep = "_")
        distance_16s <- phylogeny_distance(aligned_microbes$a)
        distance_its2 <- its2_distance(aligned_microbes$b)
        append_result(run_mantel(distance_16s, distance_its2, comparison_16s_its2, "16S vs ITS2"))
        append_procrustes(run_procrustes(distance_16s, distance_its2, comparison_16s_its2))
      }
      aligned_16s_phys <- align_phyloseq_physiology(ps16_species, physiology_raw, time_point, treatment_name, species_filter)
      aligned_its2_phys <- align_phyloseq_physiology(its2_species, physiology_raw, time_point, treatment_name, species_filter)
      for (trait_set_name in names(physiology_trait_sets)) {
        traits <- physiology_trait_sets[[trait_set_name]]
        if (!is.null(aligned_16s_phys)) { phys_dist <- physiology_distance(aligned_16s_phys$physiology, traits); if (!is.null(phys_dist)) append_result(run_mantel(phylogeny_distance(aligned_16s_phys$ps), phys_dist, comparison, paste("16S vs", trait_set_name))) }
        if (!is.null(aligned_its2_phys)) { phys_dist <- physiology_distance(aligned_its2_phys$physiology, traits); if (!is.null(phys_dist)) append_result(run_mantel(its2_distance(aligned_its2_phys$ps), phys_dist, comparison, paste("ITS2 vs", trait_set_name))) }
      }
    }
  }
}

mantel_results <- bind_rows(mantel_results) %>% arrange(pair_type, comparison)
mantel_results
procrustes_results <- bind_rows(procrustes_results) %>% arrange(comparison)
procrustes_results
```

# Partial Mantel sensitivity analysis

Partial Mantel tests are exploratory tests of whether the association between two distance matrices remains after conditioning on the third. They are run only for all-species comparisons within each time point and treatment because the species-specific three-way overlaps are too small. Each test uses only corals with complete 16S, ITS2, and overall-physiology data; overall physiology excludes P:R.

```{r partial-mantel-tests}
set.seed(20261027)
partial_mantel_groups <- data.frame(Time.Point = c("T0", "T1", "T1", "TF", "TF"), Treatment = c(NA, "Ambient", "High", "Ambient", "High"), label = c("T0", "T1_Ambient", "T1_High", "TF_Ambient", "TF_High"))
partial_mantel_traits <- physiology_trait_sets[["overall physiology"]]

run_partial_mantel <- function(x_distance, y_distance, control_distance, comparison, association) {
  shared <- sort(Reduce(intersect, list(labels(x_distance), labels(y_distance), labels(control_distance))))
  if (length(shared) < 10) return(NULL)
  x_distance <- as.dist(as.matrix(x_distance)[shared, shared])
  y_distance <- as.dist(as.matrix(y_distance)[shared, shared])
  control_distance <- as.dist(as.matrix(control_distance)[shared, shared])
  result <- vegan::mantel.partial(x_distance, y_distance, control_distance, method = "pearson", permutations = mantel_permutations)
  data.frame(comparison = comparison, association = association, n = length(shared), r_partial = unname(result$statistic), p = result$signif)
}

partial_mantel_results <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(partial_mantel_groups)), function(i) {
  group <- partial_mantel_groups[i, ]
  treatment_name <- if (is.na(group$Treatment)) NULL else group$Treatment
  ps16_group <- subset_phyloseq_group(ps_16s, group$Time.Point, treatment_name)
  its2_group <- subset_phyloseq_group(ps_its2, group$Time.Point, treatment_name)
  physiology_group <- physiology_raw %>% filter(Time.Point == group$Time.Point) %>% filter(if_all(all_of(partial_mantel_traits), ~ !is.na(.)))
  if (!is.null(treatment_name)) physiology_group <- physiology_group %>% filter(Treatment == treatment_name)
  physiology_group <- physiology_group %>% mutate(gauntlet_key = make_key(.))
  shared <- sort(Reduce(intersect, list(sample_names(ps16_group), sample_names(its2_group), physiology_group$gauntlet_key)))
  if (length(shared) < 10) return(NULL)
  ps16_group <- prune_samples(shared, ps16_group)
  its2_group <- prune_samples(shared, its2_group)
  physiology_group <- physiology_group %>% slice(match(shared, gauntlet_key))
  distance_16s <- phylogeny_distance(ps16_group)
  distance_its2 <- its2_distance(its2_group)
  distance_physiology <- physiology_distance(physiology_group, partial_mantel_traits)
  bind_rows(run_partial_mantel(distance_16s, distance_physiology, distance_its2, group$label, "16S vs physiology | ITS2"), run_partial_mantel(distance_its2, distance_physiology, distance_16s, group$label, "ITS2 vs physiology | 16S"), run_partial_mantel(distance_16s, distance_its2, distance_physiology, group$label, "16S vs ITS2 | physiology"))
}) %>% bind_rows()

partial_mantel_results
```

# 16S–ITS2 Procrustes plots

Each arrow joins the 16S and ITS2 positions for one matched coral sample. These diagnostic plots show the same all-species comparisons summarized by the Procrustes tests above.

```{r procrustes-plots, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
procrustes_plot_groups <- data.frame(
  Time.Point = c("T0", "T1", "T1", "TF", "TF"),
  Treatment = c(NA, "Ambient", "High", "Ambient", "High"),
  label = c("T0", "T1 Ambient", "T1 High", "TF Ambient", "TF High")
)

procrustes_plot_data <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(procrustes_plot_groups)), function(i) {
  group <- procrustes_plot_groups[i, ]
  treatment_name <- if (is.na(group$Treatment)) NULL else group$Treatment
  ps16_group <- subset_phyloseq_group(ps_16s, group$Time.Point, treatment_name)
  its2_group <- subset_phyloseq_group(ps_its2, group$Time.Point, treatment_name)
  aligned <- align_phyloseq_pair(ps16_group, its2_group)
  if (is.null(aligned)) return(NULL)
  pcoa_16s <- ape::pcoa(phylogeny_distance(aligned$a))$vectors
  pcoa_its2 <- ape::pcoa(its2_distance(aligned$b))$vectors
  axes <- min(ncol(pcoa_16s), ncol(pcoa_its2))
  fit <- vegan::procrustes(pcoa_16s[, seq_len(axes), drop = FALSE], pcoa_its2[, seq_len(axes), drop = FALSE])
  data.frame(sample = rownames(fit$X), x_16s = fit$X[, 1], y_16s = fit$X[, 2], x_its2 = fit$Yrot[, 1], y_its2 = fit$Yrot[, 2], group = group$label)
}) %>% bind_rows()

procrustes_panel_labels <- procrustes_results %>% filter(comparison %in% c("T0_all", "T1_Ambient_all", "T1_High_all", "TF_Ambient_all", "TF_High_all")) %>% mutate(group = c("T0", "T1 Ambient", "T1 High", "TF Ambient", "TF High")[match(comparison, c("T0_all", "T1_Ambient_all", "T1_High_all", "TF_Ambient_all", "TF_High_all"))], panel = paste0(group, "\n n = ", n, "; r = ", sprintf("%.2f", procrustes_correlation), "; p = ", format.pval(p, digits = 2, eps = 0.001)))
procrustes_plot_data <- left_join(procrustes_plot_data, procrustes_panel_labels[, c("group", "panel")], by = "group")

procrustes_plot <- ggplot(procrustes_plot_data) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = x_16s, y = y_16s, xend = x_its2, yend = y_its2), colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.35, arrow = grid::arrow(length = grid::unit(1.5, "mm"))) +
  geom_point(aes(x = x_16s, y = y_16s, colour = "16S"), size = 2) +
  geom_point(aes(x = x_its2, y = y_its2, colour = "ITS2"), size = 2, shape = 17) +
  facet_wrap(~panel, ncol = 3) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("16S" = "#0072B2", "ITS2" = "#D55E00"), name = NULL) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = "Procrustes axis 1", y = "Procrustes axis 2", title = "Alignment of 16S and ITS2 community structure") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) + theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))

dir.create("Figures", showWarnings = FALSE)
ggsave("Figures/Gauntlet_16S_ITS2_Procrustes_all_species.pdf", procrustes_plot, width = 12, height = 8)
ggsave("Figures/Gauntlet_16S_ITS2_Procrustes_all_species.png", procrustes_plot, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)
procrustes_plot
```

# 16S–ITS2 Procrustes plots by species

```{r procrustes-plots-by-species, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
species_procrustes_plot_data <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(procrustes_plot_groups)), function(i) {
  group <- procrustes_plot_groups[i, ]
  treatment_name <- if (is.na(group$Treatment)) NULL else group$Treatment
  lapply(species_order, function(species_name) {
    ps16_group <- subset_phyloseq_group(ps_16s, group$Time.Point, treatment_name, species_name)
    its2_group <- subset_phyloseq_group(ps_its2, group$Time.Point, treatment_name, species_name)
    aligned <- align_phyloseq_pair(ps16_group, its2_group)
    if (is.null(aligned)) return(NULL)
    pcoa_16s <- ape::pcoa(phylogeny_distance(aligned$a))$vectors
    pcoa_its2 <- ape::pcoa(its2_distance(aligned$b))$vectors
    axes <- min(ncol(pcoa_16s), ncol(pcoa_its2))
    if (axes < 2) return(NULL)
    fit <- vegan::procrustes(pcoa_16s[, seq_len(axes), drop = FALSE], pcoa_its2[, seq_len(axes), drop = FALSE])
    data.frame(sample = rownames(fit$X), x_16s = fit$X[, 1], y_16s = fit$X[, 2], x_its2 = fit$Yrot[, 1], y_its2 = fit$Yrot[, 2], group = group$label, comparison = paste(c(group$Time.Point, treatment_name, species_name), collapse = "_"))
  }) %>% bind_rows()
}) %>% bind_rows()

species_procrustes_panel_labels <- procrustes_results %>% filter(!grepl("_all$", comparison)) %>% mutate(species = sub("^(T0|T1_Ambient|T1_High|TF_Ambient|TF_High)_", "", comparison), species = gsub("_", " ", species), panel = paste0(species, "\n n = ", n, "; r = ", sprintf("%.2f", procrustes_correlation), "; p = ", format.pval(p, digits = 2, eps = 0.001)))
species_procrustes_plot_data <- left_join(species_procrustes_plot_data, species_procrustes_panel_labels[, c("comparison", "panel")], by = "comparison")

species_procrustes_plots <- lapply(unique(species_procrustes_plot_data$group), function(group_name) {
  ggplot(filter(species_procrustes_plot_data, group == group_name)) +
    geom_segment(aes(x = x_16s, y = y_16s, xend = x_its2, yend = y_its2), colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.35, arrow = grid::arrow(length = grid::unit(1.5, "mm"))) +
    geom_point(aes(x = x_16s, y = y_16s, colour = "16S"), size = 2) +
    geom_point(aes(x = x_its2, y = y_its2, colour = "ITS2"), size = 2, shape = 17) +
    facet_wrap(~panel, ncol = 2) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("16S" = "#0072B2", "ITS2" = "#D55E00"), name = NULL) +
    coord_equal() +
    labs(x = "Procrustes axis 1", y = "Procrustes axis 2", title = paste("16S-ITS2 Procrustes by species:", group_name)) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) + theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
})
names(species_procrustes_plots) <- unique(species_procrustes_plot_data$group)

for (group_name in names(species_procrustes_plots)) ggsave(paste0("Figures/Gauntlet_16S_ITS2_Procrustes_", gsub(" ", "_", group_name), "_by_species.pdf"), species_procrustes_plots[[group_name]], width = 10, height = 8)
species_procrustes_plots[[1]]
```
